cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you go, check that window latch. I taught you to leave a room secure.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Nearly finished. What did I teach you about checking the whole room? That curtain's moving.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's the fan, not the window. I'll switch it off.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you found the cause. Just show me which switch before you go; I want to be sure you aren't stopping the clock again.

reason: Make the moving curtain a second check in a taught room routine and turn B fan solution into one final demonstration, with backhanded credit for diagnosis.
